name: Do I need a permit for interior layout changes in Denver?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for interior layout changes in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only if the reconfiguration changes the floor plan, structural elements, doorways, windows, ductwork, or plumbing/electrical fixture locations. Simple like-for-like replacements usually do not need a permit, but interior changes that alter the plan commonly do.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often yes, if the project changes the floor plan or structural/mechanical systems. Simple like-for-like replacements usually do not require one.
